question: Which day has been declared by the World Health Organization as Hand Hygiene Day?
solution: The correct answer is __**5th May.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • World Hand Hygiene Day is observed on May 5 every year, the theme for this year was SAVE LIVES: Clean your hands • The day is organized by the World Health Organization. The primary objective is to make everyone aware of how important it is to keep our hands clean which not only protects us but others too. • This theme is perfectly in sync with the current pandemic of COVID-19. • Everyone needs to keep their hands clean in order to save themselves from coronavirus. • WHO has suggested washing our hands for 20 seconds to thoroughly clean them.
